title: Elements de Geometrie Algebrique (EGA): French Originals and English Translation Working Draft
version: 2026-05-30 EGA record with 514-page standalone EGA IV sections 1-21 reader
description:
Public EGA record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page collects coherent French original/reference PDFs for EGA, a broad English translation working draft, and a standalone EGA IV English working reader, with TeX/source artifacts in ZIP files.

Human-readable contents. The top-level files begin with the broad English working-draft reader and the standalone EGA IV sections 1-21 reader, followed by the eight NUMDAM/PMIHES French original/reference PDFs: EGA I, EGA II, EGA III parts 1-2, and EGA IV parts 1-4. The ZIP artifacts contain the EGA 0_IV sections 15 through 23 translation TeX supplement, the current EGA IV main-text translation supplement, the standalone EGA IV PDF/TeX package, and the full current TeX/source package.

Status at a glance.

  • French originals from NUMDAM: [##########] 8/8 EGA PMIHES volumes present.
  • Broad English translation reader: [####------] useful working draft; EGA I and EGA II are present from the community translation base, with additional EGA 0_IV and EGA IV material added locally.
  • Standalone EGA IV reader: [##########] sections 1 through 21 are present in a 514-page standalone working draft.
  • EGA 0_IV local continuation: [##########] sections 15 through 23 are present as substantive working translations.
  • Whole EGA completion against the long-term goal: [#####-----] still far from a complete translated and proofread edition, especially for EGA III and later preliminaries.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [----------] working draft for checking and continuation, not a certified critical edition.

Provenance. The French source/reference PDFs are from NUMDAM PMIHES. The English TeX tree is based on the public ryankeleti/ega community translation project, with local continuation work added for EGA 0_IV and EGA IV from the French source PDFs.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current public-facing EGA record, organized as reader PDFs first and source/artifact ZIPs later. Latest update adds a standalone EGA IV sections 1-21 reader and TeX/PDF supplement.
